snippet.title: Smartest Country Comparison
snippet.description:
Is the stereotype of Asians being smart true? We compare the most intelligent country by IQ, how easy is it for the average person in that particular country to absorb and learn new things. We compare 187 countries and rank them according to their intelligence quotient. 

Note: Average IQ of 100 and standard deviation of 15 was standardized as the British mean. 100 IQ does not imply global or country average. 

Disclaimer: This is based from a research paper from "IQ and the Wealth of Nations" (Richard Lynn, Tatu Vanhanen, M. Stuart, 2002) and may be outdated. While IQ represents that it is easier to learn new things, it is not necessarily means causation. Other factors such as creativity, perseverance and passion affects intelligence too. The data is for information purpose only and should be used with caution. 

Countries excluded due to lack of information: Grenada, Monaco, Palau, San Marino, South Sudan, Timor Leste, Tuvalu, Vatican City
